title: PSP journey
description: The requirement spec for the Patient Support Program template (journey.yaml).

journey.title: Journey code
journey.description: A short code for the program, e.g. enhertu_pap.

roles.title: Who uses it
roles.description: Each role that signs in, keyed by its name.

masters.title: Reference lists
masters.description: Masters such as city, doctor and hospital.

skus.title: Products
skus.description: Products that can be dispensed, keyed by SKU.

types.title: Document types
types.description: A prescription type is seeded in every journey.

programs.title: Programs
programs.description: One entry per program a patient can be enrolled onto.

extra_modules.title: Extra modules
extra_modules.description: Capabilities outside the template vocabulary. Keep them few.

adverse_events.title: Adverse events
adverse_events.description: `awareness_date` and `serious` are built in; never declare them.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: A single role, or a list of roles.

sees_only.title: Sees only
sees_only.description: `own` scopes every screen to the rows that point at the signed-in user.

scope_field.title: Scope field
scope_field.description: The field on each record that points at the user, used with `sees_only: own`.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: The pages in this role's sidebar, in order.

options.title: Options
options.description: The allowed values of a choice field.

to.title: Links to
to.description: The master this field points at, by its code.

multiple.title: Many
multiple.description: A link to many rows. Becomes its own mapping record.

formItem.title: Form field
formItem.description: A field already declared under `attributes:`; add `{ required: true }` to make it mandatory on the form.

start.title: Start state
start.description: Exactly one state is the start.

stateList.title: States
stateList.description: The stages a record moves through. Exactly one has `start: true`.

actionItem.title: Action
actionItem.description: An action from the template vocabulary, bare or with a value, e.g. `add_timeline_entry: "Enrolled"`.

any.title: Any of
any.description: At least one condition must hold.

explain.title: Explanations
explain.description: What the user is told when a condition blocks them, keyed by field; `prefix` leads the message.

custom.title: Custom rules
custom.description: Rules the vocabulary cannot express, in plain English.

customActions.title: Custom actions
customActions.description: Extra behaviour at a point the template already has, described in plain English.

customRequirements.title: Custom requirements
customRequirements.description: Requirements the vocabulary cannot express at all.

stepList.title: Steps
stepList.description: How a record moves between states.

no_access.title: No access
no_access.description: The role must not see this list at all.

shows.title: Shows
shows.description: For a custom column: what it shows, in plain English.

shows_from.title: Shows from
shows_from.description: Which attribute of the linked row to display.

featured.title: Featured
featured.description: Shown on the row rather than in its menu.

asks.title: Confirmation
asks.description: The question a confirm action asks.

access.title: Access
access.description: Per role. Say `no_access: true` explicitly — silence is not a denial.

sort.title: Default sort
sort.description: A field name; prefix `-` for descending.

owned_by.title: Owned by
owned_by.description: A scoped role sees only rows whose field points at them.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: The wording the patient agrees to.

evidence_document.title: Evidence document
evidence_document.description: A document type code that holds the signed consent.

patientConsent.title: Consent
patientConsent.description: Data-processing consent always blocks patient creation until granted.

enabled.title: Needed
enabled.description: Mark a suggested master `enabled: false` rather than deleting it.

app_user_role.title: Rows sign in as
app_user_role.description: Each row becomes a signed-in user of this role.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Flags a team applies and removes by hand. Not the lifecycle.

earns_credit.title: Earns credit
earns_credit.description: A paid order that accrues to the wallet.

spends_credit.title: Spends credit
spends_credit.description: A free dispense that redeems from the wallet.

lines_at.title: Products chosen
lines_at.description: `create`, or `{ step: <step label> }` for a later step.
